name: smwmusic-genesis-watcher-of-the-skies
title: Genesis - Watcher of the Skies
description:
An uptempo rock song in 6/4 time by English progressive rock band Genesis. Inspired by a passage in Arthur C. Clark's short story "Childhood's End", about an immortal alien who visits earth after all the humans are dead. Swirling organs, driving bass line, furious drums, soaring vocals, and a chilling guitar solo. Perfect for hi octane sky and space themed levels. Originally ported for The Rock 'n' Roll Mario Show. Credit is not necessary but always appreciated.

For though your ship be sturdy, no mercy has the sea. Will you survive on the Ocean of Being?
